basics.name: Lindsey Bieda
basics.label: Staff Engineering Manager
basics.summary: Engineering leader with over a decade of experience building and scaling full-stack products, managing globally distributed teams, and launching AI-integrated systems from the ground up. Combines deep technical proficiency in backend architecture, modern web frameworks, and API design with a people-first approach to mentorship, team development, and cross-functional collaboration.
basics.tagline: Building scalable, mission-driven technology solutions that empower teams and deliver real-world impact

highlights: Currently leading the FM Foundations team at LaunchDarkly to build core feature management experience
Led GitHub Models from team formation to launch, managing a 10-person global team and delivering key previews at GitHub Universe 2024 and Microsoft Build 2025
Directed GitHub Copilot feature rollouts, including Issue Summarization and PR integration
Introduced an engineering rotation program to reduce burnout and boost morale, later adopted across multiple teams

work.name: LaunchDarkly
work.summary: Led a 10-member engineering team focused on product-led growth, developer onboarding, and SDK activation - driving funnel improvements, cross-functional product delivery, and individual career development across a newly formed team.
highlights: Drove a 4x improvement in SDK install conversion rate (4% → 16%), a core activation metric for LaunchDarkly's product-led growth strategy
Led four concurrent product workstreams — Flag Rollback, Vercel Marketplace integration, Agentic Onboarding, and MCP Marketplace submissions — maintaining delivery momentum across a 10-engineer team
Established the Foundation team from a three-team merger (Growth, FM Next, FM Foundations), defining mission, rituals, Jira board structure, and ownership scope within the first 90 days

Drove career development across three engineers simultaneously — including a successful promotion nomination backed by seven external stakeholders — through structured goal-setting, skills coaching, and performance documentation
Contributed directly as an IC alongside management responsibilities, personally shipping the 400KB flag size enforcement API, the Block In-Use Variants feature, and a CLI signup command

work.name: GitHub
work.summary: Oversee engineering teams across multiple regions to develop and deliver AI-powered developer tools, driving strategic product launches and fostering individual career growth. Lead cross-functional efforts from team formation to public rollouts, aligning technical execution with organizational goals.
highlights: Directed end-to-end development of GitHub Copilot capabilities featured at GitHub Universe, including Issue Summarization and Pull Request integration, by coordinating a 7-person team
Reorganized team during Copilot for PRs rollout, preserving delivery timelines and team engagement throughout the transition
Built and led a new 10-member engineering team across North America and APAC to develop GitHub Models, a product distinct from Copilot
Spearheaded the initial public preview of GitHub Models at Universe 2024, followed by its integration into repositories and launch at Microsoft Build 2025
Managed a team of 9 engineers across three concurrent projects, guiding technical direction and enabling collaboration with product and design stakeholders
Provided mentorship that led to the promotion of two engineers from SE3 to Senior Engineer by supporting goal-setting, skills development, and performance planning

work.name: GitHub
work.summary: Served as the primary lead for the GitHub Discussions team, ensuring consistent progress, supporting peers, and stepping in as interim manager when needed. Drove internal programs and external partnerships that influenced broader engineering and community practices.
highlights: Designed and implemented a pilot engineering rotation program to reduce fatigue and improve engagement, adopted across multiple teams after initial success
Established the blueprint for organizing company-wide hackathons, leveraging lessons from successful departmental events to influence GitHub's broader approach
Collaborated with the GitHub Sponsors team to launch a Patreon integration, expanding funding options for open-source creators directly through the platform

work.name: GitHub
work.summary: Led and supported GitHub Discussions through team leadership, platform migration, and technical improvements. Played a key role in enhancing developer experience and internal team operations during a period of organizational transition.
highlights: Acted as interim manager for six months, overseeing team workflows, providing guidance, and ensuring consistent project progress
Modularized an oversized routes file into smaller components, improving codebase structure and maintenance
Served as lead point of contact for external collaborators, driving alignment and keeping workstreams on track
Assisted in transitioning GitHub's broader community to the Discussions platform, helping scale engagement and adoption

work.name: Stitch Fix
work.summary: Contributed to building personalized shopping experiences at Stitch Fix by developing client-facing features and enhancing the direct purchase platform. Focused on delivering scalable solutions that supported influencer collaborations and dynamic e-commerce flows.
highlights: Developed a collaborative shopping feature in partnership with an influencer, enabling shared client engagement
Built dynamic shopping experiences tailored to individual client preferences, improving user interaction and satisfaction
Enhanced the direct purchase platform to support broader product discovery and increase conversion opportunities

work.name: GitHub
work.summary: Focused on improving platform safety and transparency as part of the Community & Safety team at GitHub. Collaborated cross-functionally to identify and mitigate abuse risks while enhancing user trust through visible change tracking.
highlights: Investigated and closed security and abuse vulnerabilities in legacy systems to improve user safety across the platform
Implemented edit history for Pull Requests, Issues, and comments, allowing users to track content changes and accountability
Partnered with product and engineering teams to proactively assess and mitigate potential abuse risks in upcoming features

work.name: Articulate Global
work.summary: Contributed to the development of e-learning tools and infrastructure at Articulate, with a focus on community engagement and seamless user access. Played a key role in scaling platform capabilities to support a growing global user base.
highlights: Built and launched the company's largest online community for e-learning professionals, fostering knowledge sharing and engagement
Designed and implemented unified SSO system across all Articulate products to simplify and secure user access
